title: Cross-architecture shadow harness and regression pipeline for INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We need a reproducible, cross-hardware regression and shadow-run harness to validate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) across heterogeneous kernel stacks. Previous pipelines focused on single-architecture golden seeds which missed regressions introduced by kernel selection and runtime reorderings. This ticket builds a shadow-run + regression pipeline that exercises: (1) Onnx/torchscript numerics simulators, (2) production runtime kernel combinations across Ampere/Blackwell/AMD Instinct variants, and (3) a golden-answer divergence metric that is robust to benign sampling noise.

Goals: 1) Detect fidelity regressions introduced by new quant profiles or kernel swaps before rollout. 2) Measure divergence across architectures and produce actionable deltas per-layer/segment. 3) Automate canary ladder for canary->staged->full rollout with automatic rollback triggers.

Scope: Build harness, integrate into CI, add telemetry and dashboard, author canary+rollback playbook. This covers weight-only INT8 profiles for GPTQ and AWQ variants; FP8 fallback experiments are out-of-scope for rollout but included in offline comparison reports.

Design decisions and trade-offs: - We run a "shadow-run" where live traffic is forked into a non-user-facing runtime that uses the candidate INT8 profile. This prioritizes fidelity checks over performance cost of shadowing. - To avoid flaky signal from sampling variability we adopt a composite metric (Golden-Answer Divergence, GAD) using normalized token-level logit differences + semantic evaluation (ROUGE-L on deterministic prompts). This is stricter than average log-prob deltas and reduces false positives. - We simulate kernel numerics with an ONNX-based numeric replay to triage whether a delta originates in quantization vs kernel math differences. This adds extra CI time but drastically reduces noisy triage work.

Instrumentation and outputs: - Per-request GAD score, per-model and per-layer delta histograms, and a service-level "regression score" used by the canary policy. - Alerts when regression score exceeds threshold on P0 and P1 customers or when cross-arch variance exceeds 1.5x baseline. - Artifacts: calibration snapshots, synthetic adversarial prompt set, golden-answer corpus, and nightly heterofleet matrix.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Shadow-run harness is able to process production-level QPS in a sampled 1% live fork for 72h without impacting frontend latency. 2) CI job exists that runs ONNX numeric replay + heterofleet kernel matrix for each candidate profile and reports GAD and per-layer deltas. 3) Dashboard shows cross-arch variance heatmap and historical deltas for last 30 days. 4) Canary policy with automatic rollback triggers (regression_score > 0.03 for P0 customers OR cross-arch stddev > 0.02) implemented and validated in staging. 5) Runbook documented and reviewed by SRE and ML·infra.
acceptance_criteria: 1% sampled shadow-run for 72h without frontend latency impact
CI job: ONNX numeric replay + heterofleet kernel matrix producing GAD and per-layer deltas
Canary policy and automatic rollback triggers implemented and exercised in staging
Runbook (playbook) reviewed by SRE and ML infra
implementation_steps: Spike: capture numeric discrepancies across A100/V100/Blackwell/Instinct using small GPT-2 style model (due 2026-03-05)
Build ONNX numeric replay harness and integrate it into an isolated CI stage
Implement GAD scoring library and unit tests; provide defensible thresholds
Add shadow-run for sampled live traffic, plumbing logs to telemetry with PII-stripping
Create heterofleet matrix job that runs candidate profile across kernel combos and outputs per-layer deltas
Wire regression_score into rollout service and author auto-rollback policy
Dashboard + alerting: include cross-arch variance heatmap and runbook links
Run staging canary ladder, exercise rollback path, and capture postmortem
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Patel: Spike completed — kernel numerics show a reproducible 0.6% token-level logit shift on Blackwell for a single attention kernel when using AWQ with per-block scales. Need deeper per-layer traces.

2026-03-04 - Luca Moretti: Implemented ONNX numeric replay prototype and validated that the replay matches runtime deltas for 90% of sampled prompts. Pushing PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5143
2026-03-06 - Priya Shen (SRE): Shadow-run orchestration design reviewed; flagged requirement to ensure sampled payloads are sanitized and max 1% sample rate enforced via rate limiter.
2026-03-08 - Design review (Dave Nguyen): Suggested adding semantic delta checks (ROUGE-L) for deterministic prompts to reduce false positives from logit reordering.
2026-03-10 - QA (Marcos Silva): CI job execution time increased by ~22m due to ONNX replay on GPU variants; we should run heterofleet matrix nightly rather than on every PR to avoid CI slowdowns.

2026-03-12 - Luca Moretti: Found a regression case where GPTQ profile + kernel A produced high GAD for long-context prompts. Mitigation: introduce per-seq-len profile guards and fallback to FP16 for >2048 seqlen for that model family. Adding as follow-up sub-issue.
